item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: http://localhost:8080.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

Join us with your little ones for a Sunday filled with Halloween fun, delicious food and great company, in collaboration with Anneler Kulübü Londra.

We’re delighted to welcome mums and their little ones to a special Halloween breakfast at Olea Social, Covent Garden, on Sunday 25 October.
Enjoy a generous traditional Turkish sharing breakfast, featuring a selection of cheeses, breakfast favourites, freshly cooked menemen and warm poğaça pastries. With unlimited Turkish tea, it’s the perfect opportunity to relax and enjoy a leisurely Sunday breakfast with loved ones.
While mums enjoy breakfast and a catch-up, little ones can join in the Halloween fun with costumes, face painting, creative arts and crafts, colouring activities, a dedicated photo area and a play corner.
Adult tickets are £45. Children aged 0–5 can enjoy the sharing breakfast with their parents free of charge. Tickets for children aged 5–11 are £15, including breakfast. Children aged 11 and over require an adult ticket.

item.title: Christmas in Covent Garden: Gather at Olea Social
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Turn Christmas lunch into an occasion

A festive lunch can be the highlight of the working week. Bring colleagues together to mark the end of the year, or meet friends for an afternoon that stretches beyond a quick meal.

Olea Social's menu draws inspiration from the food cultures of Turkey, Greece, Spain, Italy and Morocco. Its approach to Mediterranean dining makes it a natural setting for a relaxed celebration with people you enjoy spending time with.

Dinner plans in the heart of Covent Garden

If you're planning a Christmas dinner, location matters. Olea Social gives your guests a central place to meet, whether dinner is the main event or part of a bigger evening in London.

Start with drinks, take your time over dinner and enjoy the company around the table. For an office Christmas party or a gathering with friends and family, share your preferred date and group size with the team so they can help you plan.

Find your way to celebrate

Every group has its own idea of a good Christmas meal. Some want a long lunch; others are looking forward to an evening of conversation, Mediterranean flavours and Christmas drinks. Olea Social offers a setting for both.

Located on Upper St Martin's Lane, a short walk from Covent Garden and Leicester Square, Olea Social is well placed for a Christmas lunch, dinner or group gathering in central London.

item.title: A Christmas to Remember in Our Private Dining Rooms
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
A Little Space for Your Celebration

Our private dining rooms bring a more personal feel to your Christmas gathering. Whether you are planning a dinner with close friends or a Christmas party for your team, having a space for your guests makes the occasion feel that little bit more special.

There is room for the conversations, the laughter and the end-of-year toast. Settle in with your guests and let us look after you.

Christmas Around Our Table

Our modern Eastern Mediterranean flavours are at the heart of our festive set menu. This is how we like to celebrate: delicious food, glasses raised and everyone enjoying themselves around the table.

Join us for a festive lunch or spend the evening with us. Whatever you have planned, we want your private dining experience to feel warm and welcoming from the moment you arrive.

A Christmas Party for the People You Work With

After a year of busy days and shared achievements, it is lovely to spend time together away from work.

Bring your team to Olea Social for a Christmas party, say thank you over a festive meal and enjoy the chance to catch up properly. Our private dining rooms offer a setting for bringing colleagues together, whether you are planning a lunchtime gathering or an evening celebration.

And if someone has a few words to say before the meal, there is always a reason for one more toast.

Friends, Family and Festive Catch-Ups

Some Christmas traditions start with a simple dinner invitation.

Perhaps it is your annual gathering with friends, a family meal before everyone heads away for the holidays or a Christmas celebration you have been looking forward to for months.

We would love to welcome you. Choose a date, bring your favourite people and enjoy being together. We will take care of the meal — and the washing-up.

Let’s Plan Your Christmas Gathering

If you have a private dining room in mind for your celebration, speak to our team about the spaces available at Olea Social.

Tell us a little about your plans, your preferred date and how many guests will be joining you. We can discuss our private dining rooms, festive menu and any dietary requirements together.

We look forward to celebrating with you.
